caveats: Calendar thirds are descriptive equal-duration bins selected after observing coverage; they are not frozen Phase 4 walk cutoffs.
Phase 3 neural features are descriptive only because the encoders were trained under the Phase 3 80/20 contract, not per global calendar walk.
Distribution and embedding drift do not by themselves prove that different encoder architectures are necessary.
Stride-one windows are dependent; paired contract summaries and bootstrap intervals are more informative than treating rows as independent.
